body.x: Greenpower Electornics (CEO Jin-Seob Son, www.gp-el.com) unveiled its display protection glass and wireless battery pack for Apple devices at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.

The company’s signature Real Tempered Glass is made with real ASAHI glass (0.1/0.33/0.21mm) to provide anti-scratch and anti-shock protection as well as better resolution. It offers better privacy for users while cutting down on glare and blue light emission.

The iPhone wireless battery pack (MFI) is an Apple and Qi certified wireless product. It contains a 1,500mAh battery inside and can either be charged with wire or wireless. The battery comes with data transmission and case protection functions and is compatible with the iPhone 6. There are two types, wireless and internal battery in this product.

Greenpower Electronics signed a license agreement with Apple in 2009 to develop supporting products for Apple. Its products are manufactured in Korea and sold in markets all over the world. In 2013 it signed a production license contract to create and develop a new line-up for Apple. Its products are currently exported to the United States, Japan, Australia, Thailand, China, France, Livia, Malaysia and other countries.

Jin-Seob Son, Greenpower Electronics’ CEO shared, “Through the upcoming CES 2015 we seek to secure a bridgehead into the North and South American markets through various meetings with potential buyers. We are targeting a safe but tangible entry into the American market.”

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), CES 2015 is the world's largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition to see the latest global trends in consumer electronics industry in one spot.

Globally recognized for its record in the number of published articles for CES, AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES every year to deliver the fastest and freshest news on the spot. This year, AVING News is using smartphones for news reporting, in line with the trend of one-person media.
